integrity: The proof characterizes power dominating sets by whether the common spine is selected and by the number of untouched pages. The generating function follows from three disjoint structural classes. A standalone checker independently applies the propagation rules to every subset in a nontrivial parameter range.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to square-page book graphs B_r with r at least two.
Triangular books and longer-cycle books are not covered.
Finite exhaustive verification over 2 <= r <= 8 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed exact book-graph formula.
title: Power domination polynomial of book graphs
